'''Gevrell''' was the assistant to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley's]] [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief of Security]]. He was married to a rather unattractive woman, and had an office in [[Spaceport Customs]].<ref name="GG7" />
